# Yellow Cabs Whitecourt

> Local taxi company in Whitecourt, Alberta, Canada. Locally owned, operated and dispatched. Book by phone: 780-527-5050.

## Contact
- Phone: 780-527-5050
- Address: Unit #7, 4723 50 Ave, Whitecourt, AB T7S 1N8, Canada
- Website: https://yellowcabswhitecourt.com/
- Payment: cash and card

## Services
- Local rides anywhere in Whitecourt: home, work, appointments, nights out
- Out-of-town and airport trips (advance booking)
- Courier and parcel delivery across Whitecourt
- Scheduled and pre-booked rides (early flights, appointments, events)
- Seniors and assisted rides
- Business accounts for local companies

## Fleet
- Sedans and minivans, black and white with a yellow checker stripe
